name: MGF Frontend
rules: Before implementing frontend work, read the relevant docs in docs/: PRD.md, openapi_api_contract.yaml, FRONTEND_STRUCTURE_GUIDE.md, design.md, GIT_WORKFLOW_GUIDE.ar-en.md

Project state: Empty-start scaffold. Route paths, providers, config, Axios client, feature API files, hooks, and types are already created. Visual pages and placeholder UI/components have been removed. Do NOT re-add placeholder screens just to fill routes — add UI only when implementing a real feature.
Stack: React 19, TypeScript 6, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 4, React Router 7, TanStack Query 5, Axios, shadcn MCP (@shadcn registry). Laravel backend at http://localhost:8000/api/v1.
Architecture: Feature/domain-based. Top-level src/ areas: app/, assets/, components/, config/, features/, hooks/, lib/, pages/, routes/, styles/, types/.

Routes are configured in src/routes/router.tsx. Current route elements render empty fragments <></>. When implementing real UI, create thin route pages in src/pages and wire them into router.tsx. Route paths: /, /login, /register, /templates, /templates/:templateId, /dashboard, /editor/projects/:projectId, /settings, /resources, /resources/new, /resources/:resourceId, /users/:userId, /admin/*, /*.

Feature folders map to OpenAPI tags: auth, me, types, templates, projects, files, generation, export, resources, social, users, admin, editor. features/editor is for editor orchestration only — keep project, file, generation, and export API calls in their own feature folders.

API rules: Use the single Axios client in src/lib/api/client.ts. Do not use raw fetch. API files live inside the owning feature under api/, split by operation (verbNoun.ts e.g. listTemplates, createProject). Use @/* for shared imports.
Hook rules: Use TanStack Query. Hooks live inside the owning feature under hooks/, split by hook (e.g. useTemplates, useTemplate, useCreateTemplate). Components call hooks, pages compose components.
Type rules: Shared cross-feature types live in src/types/api.ts. Feature-specific request/response/parameter types live in the owning feature under types/ (one type per file, camelCase).

Page rules: Pages stay thin — they read route params, compose feature components, pass simple props. No Axios/fetch calls, no mutation orchestration, no fake business logic, no large domain workflows.

shadcn rules: Use shadcn MCP (@shadcn) for UI primitives. Keep generated primitives in src/components/ui, layout wrappers in src/components/layout, feature-specific composition in src/features/<feature>/components. Do not hand-roll common primitives (button, input, dialog, tabs, etc.) when shadcn provides them. Do not add placeholder UI just to fill empty routes.

Styling: Tailwind CSS. Global styles in src/index.css and src/styles/theme.css. Follow design.md for visual direction: colors (cyan accent #09B8C4), fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans body, JetBrains Mono code), spacing tokens (r4/r8/r12/r16 radius, 52px nav).

Naming conventions: React components PascalCase.tsx, pages PascalCase.tsx, hooks useThing.ts, API files verbNoun.ts, type files camelCase.ts. Components PascalCase, hooks useCamelCase, API functions verb-first.
TypeScript strict rules: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, erasableSyntaxOnly, verbatimModuleSyntax. Use type-only imports where appropriate.
Verification: After code changes, run 'npm run build'. Run 'npm run lint' for significant changes. Docs-only changes skip build.

Git workflow (docs/GIT_WORKFLOW_GUIDE.ar-en.md): Branch prefixes — feature/, bugfix/, hotfix/, release/, chore/, docs/. Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: <type>[optional scope]: <description>. Types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, chore, test.
Git safety: Do not revert unrelated user changes. Before summarizing work, check 'git status --short'. Mention any files left untracked or intentionally unstaged.

Design tokens from design.md: --bg, --sur, --sur2, --sur3, --bor (blue), --bor2, --t1, --t2, --t3, --acc, --cy (#09B8C4 cyan accent), --cy-d, --cy-b. Dark mode via .dark class. Motion: 0.15-0.2s transitions, fade+translateY entrances.

Editor layout (design.md): 3-column — 200px left (layouts/slides), 1fr center (canvas 16:10), 270px right (Theme|Content|Style|AI tabs). Features/editor owns this UI but imports data from features/projects, features/files, features/generation, features/export.
Auth pages: Split layout — 60% left form, 40% right panel with feature list and testimonial. Tabs for Sign In / Register. Uses features/auth hooks.
Landing page: Hero with eyebrow badge, stats row, 3-column feature grid, featured templates. Marketing feel.
Marketplace: Header + filter bar (chips: All, Presentation, Website, Resume, Post, Carousel, Infographic) + auto-fill grid of template cards.
Template detail: 2-column — 1fr main (preview, info, files, comments) + 300px sidebar (clone button, upvote, about, tags).
Profile page: Header (avatar 62px, name, handle, stats) + tabs (Templates | Projects) + grids.
Add template: Two-step flow — Build manually (form) or Generate with AI (routes to ai-gen wizard).
AI Generation wizard: 2-column — 1fr main (prompt textarea, model selector, type grid, layer checkboxes) + 360px side panel (generation log, previous templates).
Modal system: Fixed overlay rgba(0,0,0,.4) backdrop, scale 0.97→1 entrance. Clone modal: title, explanation, project name, locale/direction selects.
Templates vs Projects: Template = community-shared base (read-only, forkable). Project = user's personal fork (fully editable). Forks credit original author.
Modular file model per project: content.json, sequance.json, slides/ (hero.html, title1.html, etc.), style.css, layout.css, context.md, rules.md, meta.json.
Output types: Presentation, Social Carousel, Poster, Infographic, Document, Website/Landing Page.
Generation modes: Full (all files), Partial (one layer), Manual Edit (CSS panel/raw editor), Upload & Inject.
Export formats: HTML, PDF, PNG/JPG, ZIP (full project), Markdown (content only), PPTX (v1.1+). Async jobs, poll until ready.
Resources community library: prompts, skills, agents, rules, MCP configs, design docs, hooks. CRUD, browse/search by kind/tags, forkable with parameterized {{variable}} placeholders.
Social features: Upvotes (polymorphic on templates and resources), bookmarks, threaded comments.

MVP scope (in): User auth, project/template CRUD, modular editor, AI generation (external + local), community gallery (browse/fork/search), exports (HTML/PDF/PNG/ZIP/MD), output types (Presentation/Poster/Carousel/Document), resources CRUD, user profiles.
MVP scope (out): PPTX (v1.1), Website output type (v1.1), real-time collab, payments, notifications, mobile app, advanced versioning, marketplace monetization, video/animation.
Path alias: @/* maps to src/* (configured in tsconfig.app.json and vite.config.ts).

explore.prompt: You are exploring the MGF frontend codebase. Focus on the feature/domain architecture, route structure, API client in src/lib/api/, feature API files, hooks, and types. Understand the scaffolding before suggesting any implementation.
